description:
A room as its index reads it (0.79.0). A room keeps an index by saving one convention file at
        `.hashn/index.md`: `convention: convention`, `dimensions` with members written inside members, and
        `file_tree: <dimension>` naming the dimension whose members are the room's folders. Returns each folder the
        index names (its parents, its children, its description, the files sitting in it, of any type; a folder
        with no files exists only here), the files in folders the index does not name (not wrong: their author's
        own), and what the index lost against its version before. In query_index the file-tree dimension is a
        column: the folder a file sits in gives its value, and a header that names another member is flagged in
        `issues`. Read only: nothing is refused, and who may read or write a room is unchanged. A room without an
        index returns `index: null` and how to keep one.
